description: Visits at 140 clinics: history review, documentation, orders, results review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies, medications, problem lists unavailable); about 36,000 visits per business day; paper downtime sustains about one clinic session
manual_workaround: Printed downtime reports (next-day schedules, medication lists) from the EHR vendor's read-only downtime service; paper forms; defer non-urgent visits
quantified_impact_basis: About 40% of visits cancelled or deferred (14,400 visits at an average of $515) plus about $1.1 million overtime and back-entry
acquired_practice_dependency: AQ-07 and AQ-08 run their own EHRs (see BP-17)

description: Contact center and front desk booking, check-in, insurance eligibility
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Front desk flow stops; eligibility errors cause denials; about 1.2 million calls a month
manual_workaround: Printed schedules; paper registration; payer portal eligibility for high-volume payers
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; primary clearinghouse (eligibility); telephony carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Contact center (about 600 agents); front desk staff
quantified_impact_basis: Rework, denials, and lost bookings at about 5% of daily revenue plus agent idle time
single_points_of_failure: Primary clearinghouse carries most eligibility transactions

description: New prescriptions and refills through the EHR and the e-prescribing network
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients cannot obtain medications; controlled-substance e-prescribing needs the certified EHR module
manual_workaround: Phone or paper prescriptions where state and federal law allow
quantified_impact_basis: Provider time and pharmacy call-backs; safety impact dominates

business_process: Clinical laboratory testing and result reporting
description: Central lab testing, autoverification, critical value calls, and result delivery to the EHR (about 26,000 results per day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Critical values must reach providers (42 CFR 493.1291(g)); specimen stability limits; CLIA test report accuracy (493.1291(a))
manual_workaround: Instrument printouts and manual result entry with second-person verification; phone critical values; send-out to reference lab for stat work
dependent_systems: LIS (SYS-03 Cloud A); instrument middleware; interface engines; SYS-01; SYS-02
dependent_third_parties: LIS software vendor; instrument vendors; courier service; reference lab (send-outs)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Laboratory Director; about 450 lab staff; central lab facility
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.15 million lab revenue per day plus about $350,000 send-out and overtime cost
acquired_practice_dependency: AQ-07 and AQ-08 send orders to the LIS from their own EHRs
single_points_of_failure: Single central lab; single LIS instance

business_process: Lab reference testing for external clients (SL-2)
description: Order entry and result delivery for about 260 client practices through the outreach portal and client interfaces
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client patients depend on results; client contracts set result turnaround commitments; shares the LIS with BP-04
manual_workaround: Fax and phone result delivery to clients; client-by-client downtime notice
dependent_systems: LIS; outreach portal (Cloud A); interface engines
quantified_impact_basis: About $350,000 outreach revenue per day plus service credits under client contracts

description: Pre-operative, intra-operative, and recovery care; about 180 cases per day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cases in progress continue on paper anesthesia records; new cases stop without history and consents; ASC emergency preparedness conditions (42 CFR 416.54)
manual_workaround: ASC downtime kits: paper anesthesia and nursing records, printed case schedules; postpone elective cases
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-05 (anesthesia machines, monitors)
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; device vendors; medical gas and utilities
quantified_impact_basis: About 180 cases a day at an average of $10,500
single_points_of_failure: EHR for pre-operative history; biomedical device networks

description: Acquire, store, read, and report studies; AI triage for urgent findings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Studies can be read at the modality; urgent findings need radiologist reads within hours; about 4,800 studies per day
manual_workaround: Modality local storage; read at modality consoles; route urgent studies to on-call radiologists by phone
dependent_systems: PACS and RIS (colocation DC-1); SYS-01; SYS-05 modalities
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.6 million imaging revenue per day

description: Charge capture, claim submission, remittance posting; 70% through the primary clearinghouse
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash: about $9.2 million a day of claims flows through the primary clearinghouse; payers accept late claims within filing limits; manual fallback is untested
manual_workaround: Queue claims; submit high-dollar claims through payer portals for the top 10 payers; move volume to the secondary clearinghouse (capacity not contracted)
dependent_third_parties: Primary clearinghouse (70%); secondary clearinghouse (18%); direct payer connections (12%); banks
quantified_impact_basis: Cash collections delayed about $9.2 million per day of outage; borrowing cost about $40,000 per day of delay (fictional revolving credit rate)
acquired_practice_dependency: AQ-06 to AQ-08 bill through the secondary clearinghouse

business_process: Patient billing, payment posting, and collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient payments can queue; statement cycles can slip a week
manual_workaround: Hold statements; accept payments by phone through the bank's virtual terminal

description: Scheduling, secure messaging, results viewing, bill pay for about 1.3 million active users and 45 client practices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracted availability for 45 client practices under SL-1; patients can call instead; secure messaging backlog creates clinical risk after 24 hours
manual_workaround: Status page; route patients to the contact center; clients use their own phones
dependent_systems: Patient-app platform (Cloud B); SYS-02; SYS-01 APIs
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; messaging and notification services
quantified_impact_basis: Bill pay deferral, contact center surge, and service credits to SL-1 clients
single_points_of_failure: Single cloud region for the app front end (second region warm standby)

description: Video visits (about 2,500 per day) and inbound calls
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Telehealth visits convert to phone visits; call routing loss blocks scheduling and triage lines
manual_workaround: Convert video visits to phone; forward main numbers to backup carrier
quantified_impact_basis: About 2,500 telehealth visits; about 30% would be lost

description: Biweekly payroll for 12,000 employees (about $32 million per run); SOX-relevant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cutoff 72 hours before pay date; wage payment laws and workforce retention
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll with adjustments through the payroll provider
quantified_impact_basis: Manual adjustments and penalties if payroll is late
acquired_practice_dependency: AQ-07 and AQ-08 employees still on legacy payroll until 2026-12-31

description: Quarterly and annual close, SOX controls, 10-Q/10-K preparation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines at quarter-end (MTD drops to 48 hours during the close window); SOX IT general controls
manual_workaround: Extend close calendar; manual journal entry controls with dual approval
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and audit fees; late filing would be Severe

description: Ordering and stocking for clinics and ASCs, including controlled substances
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clinics and ASCs hold about 5 days of stock; controlled-substance records must stay accurate
manual_workaround: Manual orders by phone and email to top distributors; paper controlled-substance logs
quantified_impact_basis: Expedite fees and stock-outs after day 3

description: Risk stratification and outreach for Medicare Advantage and value-based contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outreach can pause for a few days; quality measure deadlines are quarterly
manual_workaround: Work from the last exported outreach lists
dependent_systems: Data warehouse (Cloud B); SYS-01; AI-005 model

business_process: Health information exchange, referrals, and records release
description: HIE interfaces, referral exchange, release of information
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Referral timeliness; records requests have regulatory response deadlines
manual_workaround: Fax and secure email for urgent referrals
dependent_systems: Interface engines (Cloud A); SYS-01; cloud fax

business_process: Clinical care at AQ-07 and AQ-08 (legacy EHRs)
description: Visits at the two acquired practices that still run their own EHR instances until migration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same patient-safety drivers as BP-01; the legacy EHRs back up nightly (actual RPO 24 hours) and their vendor contract states a 24-hour RTO
manual_workaround: Paper downtime forms; no read-only downtime service exists for these EHRs
dependent_systems: AQ-07 EHR; AQ-08 EHR; legacy directories; flat site networks
dependent_third_parties: Two legacy EHR vendors; local IT support firms
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 180 providers and staff at 9 sites
quantified_impact_basis: About 870 visits per day at the two practices
acquired_practice_dependency: Yes: AQ-07 and AQ-08 are the process
single_points_of_failure: Legacy EHR servers (single instance each, no tested restore)
